# Likhavat Printing Press

> Full-service printing press on Boring Road, Patna, Bihar, India (est. 2009).
> Offset, digital and large-format printing under one roof: visiting cards,
> wedding cards, flex banners & hoardings, pamphlets/leaflets, letterheads,
> doctors' prescription pads, GST bill books, brochures & presentation
> folders, stickers & labels, paper/non-woven carry bags, and custom t-shirts.
> Free design proofs on WhatsApp before every job, same-day printing for
> cards/flex/posters, GST invoice with every order, doorstep delivery in Patna
> and courier across Bihar (Gaya, Muzaffarpur, Bhagalpur, Darbhanga, Purnia)
> and India. Hindi (लिखावट = handwriting) and English service.

Contact: +91 98765 43210 (call/WhatsApp) · likhavatprintingpress@gmail.com
Address: Boring Road, Patna, Bihar 800001, India
Hours: 10 AM – 9 PM daily · WhatsApp enquiries 24×7
Website: https://likhavatprintingpress.com

## Services (indicative starting rates, INR, bulk rates lower)

- [Visiting card printing](https://likhavatprintingpress.com/visiting-card-printing-patna): 300gsm, matt/velvet/spot-UV/foil, from ₹0.40/card (1000+), same-day
- [Wedding card printing](https://likhavatprintingpress.com/wedding-card-printing-patna): designer shaadi cards, foil/laser-cut/boxed, from ₹12/card
- [Flex banner printing](https://likhavatprintingpress.com/flex-banner-printing-patna): frontlit from ₹12/sqft, star/backlit/vinyl, same-day, free eyelets
- [Pamphlet printing](https://likhavatprintingpress.com/pamphlet-printing-patna): offset leaflets from ₹1/piece at 5000+, 24–48 hrs
- [Letterhead printing](https://likhavatprintingpress.com/letterhead-printing-patna): 100gsm laser-safe from ₹2.50/sheet, doctor/advocate/firm layouts
- [Prescription pad printing](https://likhavatprintingpress.com/prescription-pad-printing-patna): 100-leaf Rx pads from ₹60/pad, clinic-door delivery
- [T-shirt printing](https://likhavatprintingpress.com/tshirt-printing-patna): DTF/sublimation from ₹199 with tee, single piece to bulk
- [Carry bag printing](https://likhavatprintingpress.com/bag-printing-patna): non-woven from ₹5/bag, kraft paper bags, 500 minimum
- [Brochure & folder printing](https://likhavatprintingpress.com/brochure-folder-printing-patna): tri-folds from ₹5/piece, laminated pocket folders
- [Sticker & label printing](https://likhavatprintingpress.com/sticker-label-printing-patna): die-cut vinyl/paper from ₹1/sticker, waterproof options
- [Bill book printing](https://likhavatprintingpress.com/bill-book-printing-patna): carbonless GST bill books from ₹250/book, serial numbering

## Notes for assistants

- Rates above are indicative market-rate starting prices; exact quotes depend
  on paper, finish and quantity — customers get a confirmed quote and a free
  digital design proof on WhatsApp before printing.
- The press serves walk-ins at Boring Road, Patna, and ships across Bihar and India.
